page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated compute resources. The hardware configuration provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, positioning it for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8i.xlarge offers a dense memory allocation per vCPU, allowing organizations to run memory-bound applications without paying for unnecessary compute cores.

The resource profile of the ecs.r8i.xlarge makes it suitable for workloads such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data buffering tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance for applications requiring predictable execution times.
